question: As of November 2026, what is the codename of the newest Node.js LTS release line?
answer: As of November 2026, the newest Node.js LTS release line is 26.x, codename "Lithium" [1][2]. It entered Active LTS on 2026-10-28 with the 26.13.0 release [1][6], and it is scheduled to receive updates through the end of April 2029 [6]. Node.js 27 is currently in the Alpha phase, so it is not an LTS line yet [1][2].

studyNotes.focus: The question asks for the codename of the newest Node.js LTS release line as of November 2026, which requires identifying the most recently promoted LTS line.

keyPoints.text: Node.js 26.x was promoted to Active LTS with codename 'Lithium' (Active LTS start 2026-10-28), making it the newest LTS line.
Node.js 24.x (Krypton) is in Maintenance LTS, with its maintenance start on 2026-10-20.
Node.js 22.x (Jod) is also an LTS line, now in Maintenance since 2025-10-21.
Node.js 27 is currently in Alpha and is not yet LTS.
